classification: Incidental subprocess lifecycle correction; no scientific extraction, model or grounding algorithm change.

observed_trigger.fixture: Fake CLI exits with returncode 0 while a same-process-group descendant inherits stdout, ignores SIGTERM and continues a finite heartbeat.
observed_trigger.before_fix: With timeout_seconds=None the reaped leader had returncode 0, but the worker remained pending and result.json was absent after a 600 ms observation window, both with and without turn.completed. Supervised cancellation stopped the fake descendants.
observed_trigger.control: Redirecting descendant stdout to DEVNULL allowed normal completion and cleanup.
observed_trigger.inference: The source path has no finite bound when the descendant keeps stdout open indefinitely: finish_process awaited stdout EOF/process.wait together before invoking the cleanup that could stop that descendant.
observed_trigger.existing_test_gap: test_finished_worker_stops_background_descendants covered descendants with stdout/stderr redirected to DEVNULL, not inherited stdout.

decision.leader_exit_detection: Observe public Process.returncode or completed I/O task; do not depend on stdout EOF or a previously awaiting Process.wait future to detect leader exit.
decision.cadence_boundary: Observation latency only. A living CLI retains unlimited duration when timeout_seconds=None; no idle/reconnect deadline was added.
decision.cleanup: Retain shielded owned-process-group TERM/KILL cleanup; permit bounded output drain after KILL and make completed cleanup idempotent.
decision.acceptance: Validate only after cleanup. Forced-undrained stdout and late reader exceptions remain nonaccepting even if an earlier event prefix contains turn.completed.
preserved_contracts: Explicit attempt timeout and cancellation behavior
Image-input integrity and exclusive attempt/archive creation
Existing managed policy, workspace sandbox and network/model flags
Exit-code, native event, final-message and archived transport checks

rationale_sources.supports: Public returncode is None while the process has not terminated; use it as the leader-exit observation.
Subprocess communication reads stdout/stderr until EOF; leader exit and pipe completion are distinct observations.

rationale_sources.observed: In the inspected local CPython implementation, an already-pending wait future is resolved only after pipe disconnection. No private asyncio API is used by the fix.

test_exited_leader_with_inherited_stdout: Completed turn and exit 0 accepts only after inherited-pipe drain and descendant cleanup
test_leader_exit_cannot_accept_a_complet: Missing EOF after bounded cleanup remains nonaccepting
regressions.cleanup_assertion: Exactly one TERM/KILL cleanup sequence; finite test watchdogs bound fixtures only.

limits: Cleanup owns only the process group created for this attempt; it does not claim to reap descendants that leave that group or unrelated processes.
A genuinely living CLI can remain waiting for its provider indefinitely when the caller selects no attempt timeout.
Passing fake/process and software tests is not model correctness, scientific source support or production deployment validation.
